capture: Two visible phone iframes; completed frames captured concurrently, with lossless raw-RGBA handoff to the video encoder. Camera poses and native drawing-buffer resolution remain unchanged.
costUse: Review only; supplied model output is identical in both builds. Cold inference and first-view cost are measured separately.
path: Four continuous sine arcs: yaw -30,+30 then pitch -30,+30; no frame interpolation.
